title: 第17章 今晚的月色不错第18章 与你成亲
content_zh:
漆木山的墓还在那里，与以往不同的是，左边单孤刀的墓已经被平了，而右边多出一座新坟，那是芩婆为李相夷立的衣冠冢。
李莲花和方多病祭拜过师父之后，李莲花就又对着自己的衣冠冢发起了呆，他好像想起来自己还有一处衣冠冢，但是却又忘了，那墓在哪里！
方多病对他现在这样时时发呆也已经有些见怪不怪了，他知道这是以前的记忆时不时就会窜出来的缘故，毕竟药魔说过，凡走过必留下痕迹，他想要不了多久，李莲花的回忆便会回来。
他也不管李莲花在一边发呆，倒是不知从哪摸出一把小铁锹，很快就在衣冠冢旁边挖了个小坑，将那帕子包好的灵位仔仔细细的放进去，又细心的将土填好，拍平。
“我还当你会替我拆了这衣冠冢。”李莲花笑着看方多病的行为，却并未阻止。
“芩婆他老人家说的对，这遮一遮满天神佛的眼也是好的，”又一想，“就是瞒过旁人也是好的，若让他们知道你还活着，必定会找出不少事来！”
“方小宝，你如今可真是没大没小，连声祖师婆婆也不肯叫了。”李莲花笑看着少年。
“又没拜师，哪里来的祖师婆婆？”方多病如今就是不想承认这儿时的戏言，他们就是朋友，好朋友，不是师徒。
“那你要不要拜师，刚好在我师父面前，彻底将云隐山一脉交托与你。”
“我才不要！”方多病有些想翻白眼，但是他忍住了，他翻起白眼实在是不好看，他不愿意让李莲花看见自己不好看的样子，“你忘了漆前辈的嘱托？”
“你怎么知道的？”李莲花没想到自己之前会将这件事也告诉他，倒是有些难为情。
“你个老狐狸，别跟我装蒜，别以为我不知道你想什么！”方小宝更没好气，如今这人也开始占自己便宜，果然身体一好，就冒坏水。
李莲花无言以对，只好又摸了摸自己的鼻子。他看见方多病满手都是土，将怀中自己的帕子拿出来帮少年细细擦拭。
方多病不闪不避，任他动作。
后山，单孤刀的坟孤零零的躺在那里，芩婆虽说帮他收了尸，可看样子也并未真心原谅这个害了自己一生的徒弟，平时也不常来，墓碑上已经积一层薄薄的灰尘。
李莲花拿出笸箩里的抹布，帮他擦拭着墓碑，一时无语，心里也不知道到底该和这师兄说什么，责备的话好像都已经说尽。
方多病看他默不作声，只是手上擦着墓碑，动作不停。
只好自己寻些事情，暂且帮这生父拔一拔坟头的荒草。他如今对这个人，也不知道要说些什么，阴谋与背叛在这荒冢面前，是多么可笑！
说恨也好，说感激也罢，都已经时过境迁，不如忘了，放过自己的好。
只是不知李莲花如何想，他只怕坟中躺着的人影响他二人的感情，可此时又不是开口的好时机，只能拿眼偷看李莲花，他在不希望自己和小花之间还有什么隔阂。

“方小宝，师兄是师兄，咱们是咱们。”李莲花心有所感，不由的开口安慰。
“知道，他是他我是我。”方多病只能如此回答，却在心中感慨，要真是这样，那就再好不过了。
“一会儿，咱们就回去！”李莲花也停下手中的动作，开始去帮方多病拔草，“师娘说给你准备了好东西，这些时候太辛苦你了。”
本来方多病还想谦虚几句，又觉得此刻说什么都是多余，只是点了点头，继续手上的动作，以便真如李莲花所说，能早点回去。
“先不要告诉师娘，我不记得这十年往事，”李莲花继续嘱咐，“我不想师娘再为我担心了，只想她以后能过的安稳。”
“好！”方小宝看着面前的老狐狸，不管是李相夷还是李莲花，他一直都很有信心，老狐狸想要做的事情，一定都会成功，做不成一定是他不想，说出的话中也满含信心，“你很快就都能想起来的！”
芩婆的药膳十分有效，加上如今天气温热，方多病半夜还难以入睡，他不想躺在单孤刀那间房中，思绪就是这样，你越想控制，它越会胡思乱想。
看了一眼窗外的月色，方多病拿着酒壶，上了房顶，喝酒赏月，想着心事。
李莲花也是如此，许久没吃过师娘的药膳了，难以入眠，再在山庄中随意走动，散心纳凉，一抬头看见了屋顶上的方小宝，飞身而起，坐在了这少年身边。
方多病看着旁边多出来的这个人，只是微微一笑，拿起那个莲花酒壶，递给来人，可李莲花并不接那酒壶，只是看着月光下这人的脸，稍微有些失神。
见他不接这酒壶，方多病也不意外，端起酒壶，将那美酒送入口中，只刚喝了一口，酒壶忽的被旁边那人从手中抢去，只见他仰头畅饮起来。
方多病只觉的好笑，这人，怎么抢来的酒更好喝嘛？又伸手从腰间拿出另一个酒壶，打开瓶塞，感慨这难得的平静，看了一眼月亮，心中感慨：“今晚的月色不错！”
“小宝。”那人低沉的嗓音在耳边响起。
不由的方多病看向旁边的人，不经意间，那人的嘴就碰到了自己的唇，方多病惊得睁大了眼睛，手中酒壶就这样咕噜噜滚落，伸手去捞，却被身边人一把揽入怀中。
李莲花也惊奇自己今日为何如此大胆，可低头看着怀中少年，又觉得这大胆才是应该，李相夷想要的，从不磨磨唧唧，从前喜欢乔婉娩，那便大胆追求，如今心中总是这少年，为何不敢让他知道？
只是光阴好像有些戏弄人了，李莲花早有此意，可不知为何，心中总有些瑟缩。方才喝那一口酒倒是提醒，什么也不如畅快重要！
看着怀中人的这双圆圆的大眼睛，又忍不住凑过去轻轻在面前少年的唇上啄了啄。李相夷从不隐藏自己的喜欢，以往的李莲花是不得不隐藏自己，如今，碧茶已解，那个大胆的李相夷又回来了。
“你，你干什么？”方多病轻声问着，却不躲不闪，任凭旁边的人还流连在自己唇上。
李莲花靠近少年耳边，压低了声音魅惑着说，“我，心悦你，那日在马车上，我其实就想亲你……”
方多病闻言有些呆愣，原来这不是自己的单相思嘛！原来一切努力都会有回报，原来爱会有回应。

再不多言，只用劲扑进李莲花怀中。又惊觉这冲击力度过大，急忙搂住心上人的腰，只生涩的用唇去碰身边人的唇角，羞红了脸，轻声低喃着，“你干嘛不早说？”
李莲花看着怀中少年人的眼睛，不由自主的吻了吻怀中人光洁的额头，才轻声开口，“以前的李莲花不敢说，现在的我替他说。”
这话简直要了方多病的命，原来以前也不是错觉，很早很早以前，他就已付出了真心，只是面前人他不敢要，现在都好了。
方多病欣喜万分，又用唇去触碰李莲花的唇，眼睛睁得大大的，他要看清李莲花的脸，从现在开始，这张脸和这张脸的主人都只属于自己。
闭上眼睛，微张薄唇，少年人第一次接了个真正的吻。
content_en:
The tomb in Qimushan is still there. The difference is that the tomb of Dan Gudao on the left has been leveled, and there is a new tomb on the right, which is the tomb erected by Qinpo for Li Xiangyi.
After Li Lianhua and Fang Duobing paid homage to their master, Li Lianhua was stunned again at his tomb. He seemed to remember that he still had a tomb, but he forgot where the tomb was!
Fang Duobing was no longer surprised that he was in a daze from time to time. He knew that this was because memories from the past would pop up from time to time. After all, the medicine demon said that wherever he walked, he would leave traces. It wouldn't take long for him to think that Li Lianhua's memories would come back.
He didn't care that Li Lianhua was dazed on the side, but he took out a small shovel from nowhere, and quickly dug a small hole next to the tomb. He carefully put the coffin wrapped in a scarf into it, and carefully filled it with soil and patted it flat.
"I thought you would tear down this tomb for me." Li Lianhua smiled at Fang Duobing's behavior, but did not stop him.
"Old Qinpo is right, it's good to cover the eyes of the gods and Buddhas in the sky." Another thought, "It's also good to hide it from others. If you let them know that you are still alive, they will definitely find out a lot of things!"
"Fang Xiaobao, you are so young now that you don't even want to call me grandma." Li Lianhua looked at the young man with a smile.
"I didn't become a disciple, where did I get my grandma from?" Fang Duobing just didn't want to admit the joke he made here. They were just friends, good friends, not masters and disciples.
"Then do you want to become a disciple? Just in front of my master, I will completely entrust the Yunyin Mountain lineage to you."
"I don't want it!" Fang Duobing wanted to roll his eyes, but he held it back. He didn't look good when he rolled his eyes. He didn't want Li Lianhua to see him looking bad. "Have you forgotten Senior Qi's instructions?"
"How did you know?" Li Lianhua didn't expect that she would tell him about this before, but she was a little embarrassed.
"You old fox, don't pretend to be with me, don't think that I don't know what you think!" Fang Xiaobao was even more angry. Now this person started to take advantage of him. As expected, when he was in good health, he got into trouble.
Li Lianhua was speechless and had no choice but to touch her nose again. He saw that Fang Duobing's hands were covered with dirt, so he took out his own handkerchief and helped the young man wipe it carefully.
Fang Duobing didn't dodge or avoid, letting him move.
In the back mountain, Shan Gudao's grave lay alone. Although Qinpo helped him collect his body, it seemed that she had not sincerely forgiven the apprentice who had harmed her life. She did not come here often, and a thin layer of dust had accumulated on the tombstone.
Li Lianhua took out the rag from the basket and helped him wipe the tombstone. She was speechless for a moment and didn't know what to say to this senior brother. It seemed that she had already said all her words of blame.
Fang Duobing saw that he was silent, just wiping the tombstone with his hand and moving non-stop.
I had no choice but to find something to do on my own, and temporarily help my biological father pull out the weeds from his grave. He didn't know what to say to this man now. Conspiracy and betrayal were so ridiculous in front of this deserted grave!
Whether you say you hate it or say you are grateful, time has passed. It is better to forget it and let yourself go.
He just didn't know what Li Lianhua thought. He was afraid that the person lying in the grave would affect their relationship, but it was not a good time to speak. He could only peek at Li Lianhua. He didn't want there to be any gap between himself and Xiaohua.
"Fang Xiaobao, senior brother is senior brother, and we are us." Li Lianhua felt something in her heart and couldn't help but comfort her.
"I know, he is him and I am me." Fang Duobing could only reply, but he sighed in his heart that if this was really the case, it would be the best.
"We'll go back in a moment!" Li Lianhua also stopped what he was doing and started to help Fang Duobing pull weeds. "My wife said she has prepared good things for you. You have been working too hard these days."
Originally, Fang Duobing wanted to be humble, but he felt thatIt was superfluous to say anything at this moment. He just nodded and continued the movements of his hands, so that he could go back as soon as possible as Li Lianhua said.
"Don't tell Master's wife yet, I don't remember the past ten years," Li Lianhua continued, "I don't want Master's wife to worry about me anymore, I just want her to live a stable life in the future."
"Okay!" Fang Xiaobao looked at the old fox in front of him. Whether it was Li Xiangyi or Li Lianhua, he had always been very confident. Whatever the old fox wanted to do, he would definitely succeed. If he couldn't do it, it must be because he didn't want to. His words were also full of confidence, "You will remember it soon!"
Qinpo's medicinal diet is very effective, and with the hot weather today, Fang Duobei still has trouble falling asleep in the middle of the night. He doesn't want to lie in Shan Gudao's room. His thoughts are like this. The more you try to control it, the more random thoughts it will have.
Glancing at the moonlight outside the window, Fang Duobing took the wine bottle and went up to the roof, drinking wine and admiring the moon, thinking about his thoughts.
The same was true for Li Lianhua. She hadn't eaten her mistress's medicinal food for a long time and couldn't fall asleep. She walked around the villa to relax and enjoy the cool air. When she looked up and saw Fang Xiaobao on the roof, she flew up and sat next to the young man.
Fang Duobing looked at the new person next to him, and just smiled slightly, picked up the lotus flask and handed it to the person, but Li Lianhua did not take the flask, but looked at the man's face under the moonlight, slightly absent-minded.
Seeing that he didn't take the jug, Fang Duobing was not surprised. He picked up the jug and put the wine into his mouth. He just took a sip when the jug was suddenly snatched from his hand by the person next to him, and he looked up and began to drink.
Fang Duobing only found it funny. How could the wine this man snatched be better? Then he reached out and took out another wine bottle from his waist, opened the cork, sighed at this rare peace, glanced at the moon, and sighed in his heart: "The moonlight is good tonight!"
"Xiaobao." The man's deep voice sounded in his ears.
Fang Duobing couldn't help but look at the person next to him, and inadvertently, the person's mouth touched his lips. Fang Duobing's eyes widened in shock, and the wine bottle rolled down from his hand. He reached out to grab it, but was picked up by the person next to him.
Li Lianhua was also surprised why she was so bold today, but when she looked down at the boy in her arms, she felt that being bold was the right thing to do. What Li Xiangyi wanted was never to complain. He used to like Qiao Wanchan, so he pursued it boldly. Now he always has this boy in his heart, why didn't he dare to let him know?
It's just that time seems to be playing tricks on people. Li Lianhua has already had this intention, but for some reason, she always shrinks in her heart. The sip of wine I just took was a reminder that nothing is as important as having fun!
Looking at the big round eyes of the person in his arms, he couldn't help but leaned over and gently pecked the lips of the young man in front of him. Li Xiangyi never hides his love. In the past, Li Lianhua had to hide himself. Now, Bicha has been resolved, and the bold Li Xiangyi is back.
"You, what are you doing?" Fang Duobing asked softly, but did not hide or dodge, letting the people next to him linger on his lips.
Li Lianhua came close to the young man's ear, lowered her voice and said seductively, "I am happy for you. That day on the carriage, I actually wanted to kiss you..."
Fang Duobing was a little stunned when he heard this. It turned out that this was his unrequited love! It turns out that all efforts will be rewarded, and love will be responded to.
Without saying any more words, he just threw himself into Li Lianhua's arms. She was shocked to realize that the impact was too great, and hurriedly hugged her sweetheart's waist, and touched the corners of the lips of the person next to her with her lips. She blushed with embarrassment and murmured softly, "Why didn't you tell me earlier?"
Li Lianhua looked into the eyes of the young man in her arms, kissed the smooth forehead of the young man in her arms involuntarily, and then spoke softly, "Li Lianhua didn't dare to say it before, but now I say it for him."
These words simply killed Fang Duobing. It turned out that it was not an illusion before. He had given his sincerity a long time ago, but he didn't dare to ask for the person in front of him. Now everything is fine.
Fang Duobing is happyExtremely excited, he touched Li Lianhua's lips with his lips again, eyes wide open, he wanted to see Li Lianhua's face clearly. From now on, this face and the owner of this face only belong to him.
Closing his eyes and opening his thin lips slightly, the young man received a real kiss for the first time.
